# Vendored code

`leanVM/` is [leanEthereum/leanVM](https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanVM) at commit
`dd51f0f5e29461b1ea43f79d8e4bb079265b5ddc` ("doc: improve the KECCAk - GKR explanation", the tip of `main` on 2026-10-25),
copied unmodified, without its `.git`, `formal/` (Lean proofs) and `doc/images/`.

All credit for the VM, the zkDSL compiler and the proof system goes to its authors.
